cases.source_quote: Original PMC10846847 Table 2 (Group 1, 2, 3 each n=70): Time 0h Group 2 Mild 15.0%, Moderate 2.1%; Group 3 Mild 34.8%, Moderate 10.1%, Severe 9.4%. Table 3: POST Group 3 66.9%; Hoarseness Group 1 15.1%, Group 2 17.2%, Group 3 71.9%; Dysphagia Group 1 15.8%, Group 2 19.0%, Group 3 70.2%. Retraction notice PMC12826944: 'The published results include multiple mathematically impossible percentages with missing raw counts despite being reported as n (%).'

cases.confidence_notes: Highest-confidence deterministic positive control: both the open-access original full text (PMC10846847) and the Cureus retraction notice (PMC12826944, Jan 22, 2026) explicitly confirm the impossible percentages for n=70.

cases.source_quote: Original PMC11221284 Table 1 (Group 3, n=30): 'Gender (%)' Male '36.6 (n=11)', Female '63.4 (n=19)'. Also Table 1 vs Table 3 Week 0 baseline contradictions (e.g., Group 3 FBS 119.9±7.2 vs 119.9±12.2; Group 4 FBS 113.6±12.5 vs 118.6±12.5). Critiqued by Malbouby, Trexler, Heathers (PMC12322552) and retracted in PMC12957198 after BMJ independent statistical review.
cases.why_impossible_claimed: For N=30, 11/30 = 36.6667% rounds to 36.7% (not 36.6%) and 19/30 = 63.3333% rounds to 63.3% (not 63.4%) under both half-up and half-even rounding. No integer k out of 30 produces 36.6% or 63.4% at 1 decimal place.
cases.confidence_notes: Note that 36.6% could arise from truncation of 36.666...% followed by computing 100 - 36.6 = 63.4%, which itself violates standard rounding for both cells. The article also contains multiple Table 1 vs Table 3 baseline mean/SD contradictions and was retracted by BMJ in September 2025 (PMC12957198).

cases.source_quote: Nick Brown mansoura_main.xls (chisq sheet, rows 780-781, DOI 10.1016/j.fertnstert.2009.07.985, Status 2021-10-25: Retracted): Nulliparous N1=123 (100/23), N2=127 (106/21), calc chi2=0.202 (p=0.653), Orig chi2=0.28, Orig p=0.83; Multiparous N1=123 (23/100), N2=127 (21/106), calc chi2=0.202 (p=0.653), Orig chi2=0.87, Orig p=0.48.
cases.why_impossible_claimed: Nulliparous and Multiparous are exact logical complements of the same 2x2 table ([[100, 106], [23, 21]] vs [[23, 21], [100, 106]]), so their chi-square statistics and p-values must be identical (Pearson chi2=0.202, p=0.653). Reporting two different chi-square values (0.28 vs 0.87) and p-values (0.83 vs 0.48) — neither matching the counts — is mathematically impossible.
cases.confidence_notes: Retracted Fertility and Sterility trial (Bordewijk ID H02) transcribed in Nick Brown's open mansoura_main.xls dataset accompanying his October 2021 Mansoura forensic analysis.
